```json
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for empowering regional and local economies to produce their own essential goods and services to the maximum extent possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Some forms of production, like carework, universal healthcare and other universal basic services—which are not prioritized by the private market — are best implemented at the national level.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The meat-and-monocrop food system must be transformed to supply far more plant-based foods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"An ecosocialist food system requires a switch to ecologically coherent forms of food cultivation, namely worker-owned agroecology and agroforestry systems.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for the democratic expenditure of society’s productive surplus, known as Dépense.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Brazilian carnaval, Mardi Gras, and feasts are examples of Dépense.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Scarcity logic under capitalism is historically specific, not a universal truth (Schmelzer et al. 2022, 127).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Global North must degrow for humanity to maximize our chances of limiting the worst effects of the climate crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
